_about: Test corrections for the data-corrections golden (made-up ids above the slice's, except quest 15 and item 159, which the slice has). Applied to the data golden's slice without Forever's quest data.

15.note: an existing record: the field is replaced

990001.note: absent, but it holds a title, a giver and a turn-in: it becomes the record

990002.note: absent and no title, giver or turn-in: reported as unused

990101.note: absent, but named and placed: it becomes the record

990102.note: absent, no name or place: reported as unused

990201.note: absent, named but not placed: reported as unused

159.note: an existing item: removing a vendor it does not have changes nothing but tags it

990301.note: absent item: an item correction cannot stand alone
